system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

The clan of Monks, warriors and revolutionaries all exist at the same time within the past of the Kuru, but what is lost is the blessings of Kuroi, the first Alpha. You hope to embody their blessings, their pride and their forgotten memory, by inheriting his will, learning the Black Okami Form.

As a Bonus action, while you have both the Miraigan active and are in the Black Fang stance, you can spend 4 Foresight, to enter the Black Okami Form. Entering this form causes your Yin Chakra to tattoo itself across your skin, in tribalistic patterns as your eyes gain black markings around them, making your gaze more intense, like that of a wolf. You can remain in this form for up to 1 minute, you become incapacitated or you are no longer in your Black Fang stance or your Miraigan isn’t active. Once you use this form, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.
